title: Video Editor (Educational Content & Social Media) - Tamabram
description:
Video Editor (Educational Content & Social Media - Tambaram 
 Role & responsibilities 
 Edit educational videos, lecture clips, student success stories, and promotional content Create trending, high-engagement reels and short-form videos for Instagram, YouTube Shorts, and Facebook Add sound effects, background music, transitions, motion graphics, and B-rolls to enhance storytelling Design eye-catching thumbnails and social media branding posters Maintain consistent brand style across all videos and creative materials Follow social media trends and turn them into ideas that suit an academic audience Work with the marketing and academic teams to plan and deliver content on schedule Organize and manage raw footage, project files, and final exports 

 Required Skills 
 Hands-on proficiency in Adobe Premiere Pro, After Effects, Photoshop. Strong knowledge of trending reel editing styles, transitions, and pacing Good understanding of sound design, SFX, and B-roll usage Skilled in thumbnail design and poster creation Good sense of timing, color correction, and visual storytelling 

 Preferred Qualifications Experience editing for educational institutes, coaching centers, or ed-tech content Basic knowledge of subtitles and captions Familiarity with social media platform formats and algorithms Ability to work under deadlines and handle multiple projects 
 Preferred candidate profile Min 1 year of relevant experience Position : Full-time Work : 6 Days in a Week 
 If interested share your resume along with the portfolio to Kiruthika@futurenorms.in or whatsapp 7667618449

Key Skills: Aftereffects,Video,Final Cut Pro,Premiere PRO,Corel,VFX,Video editing,Audio
